# Adversarial vectors

**26 of 26 adversarial vectors are denied** under the starter policy, policy version `starter-1`.

Every row below was produced by evaluating the vector against [`tests/fixtures/starter-policy.yaml`](../tests/fixtures/starter-policy.yaml) with the same local engine the SDK ships. The decision and reason columns are what the engine returned, not a description of what it is meant to return. The vectors themselves are in [`tests/vectors/injections.jsonl`](../tests/vectors/injections.jsonl), one JSON object per line.

Ids are positional: `V01` is the first line of the fixture. They stay stable as long as vectors are appended rather than reordered.
